categories.name: validation
categories.evidence: Carries the Validation label and modifies invalid block handling and block index traversals in ActivateBestChain in src/validation.cpp.
categories.rationale: This refactor removes redundant block index loops and duplicate log entries during invalid block handling. When ActivateBestChain processes an invalid block, it was triggering duplicate SetBlockFailureFlags and RecalculateBestHeader traversals and duplicate log lines (PR description). While eliminating duplicate traversals in failure handling is a worthwhile cleanup, invalid chain handling is an uncommon path and the change does not alter consensus rules or core validation performance.
